claims.evidence: Witness photos show stacks of wooden pallets arranged for use as material/stacking bases.

claims.claim: It is available for pickup only in Port Harcourt.
claims.evidence: Witness report contains no location/availability details beyond the item photos.

risks.risk: Non-standard size or mixed sizes in the lot (affects compatibility and resale/use).
risks.proof: A clear photo showing pallet dimensions (or a tape measure) and/or the full pallet marking/size code on the stringer/corner stamp.

risks.risk: Damage/defects not fully visible: cracks, broken boards, missing nails/fasteners, or severe warping (affects usability and safety).
risks.proof: Close-up clips of all four corners and the underside/stringers of at least 3 pallets, showing any cracks, missing boards, and fastener condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used pallets with possible minor damage (not guaranteed repairable).

risks.risk: Treatment status unknown beyond the visible “EPAL” mark (heat-treated vs chemically treated affects compliance and buyer acceptance).
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the full treatment stamp/marking (including any IPPC/HT/MB codes) on multiple pallets.

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (how many pallets are included).
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the full lot count (e.g., pallets laid out in a grid) or a count sheet/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price per pallet as worst-case for smaller quantities (no bulk discount assumed).

risks.risk: Condition issues like moisture, rot, odor, or infestation (can make pallets unusable).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of wood grain at corners and any dark/soft areas, plus a quick smell/inspection note from the pickup location (video clip).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damp/dirty used pallets (no guarantee against rot/infestation).

risks.risk: Load rating/certification details not shown (affects industrial buyers).
risks.proof: Photos of any load rating/certification markings beyond “EPAL”, and any repair/maintenance stamps.
risks.if_unproven: Price as general-purpose used EPAL-stamped pallets without guaranteed certification details.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the full pallet dimensions (length/width/height) with a tape measure or size code visible.
Provide close-up images/videos of at least 3 pallets: all four corners, underside/stringers, and any broken/missing boards or fasteners.
Show the complete IPPC/treatment stamp on multiple pallets (including HT/MB or other treatment codes).
Confirm the total number of pallets in the lot with a wide shot that allows counting.
Show any moisture/rot/infestation indicators: close-ups of corners and underside plus a short inspection video.
response.reason: The witness report identifies the item as used EPAL-stamped wooden pallets suitable as stacking bases, so a worst-case used-pallet valuation is possible; however, key pricing factors (dimensions, treatment stamp details, exact count, and damage severity) are not fully verifiable from the provided observations.
